title: sub_pipeline step config
description: Runs another published pipeline as a nested step, locally or on a named remote server, and captures its output in the parent context.

pipeline_id.description: Id of the pipeline to run, in the local registry or on server.

server.description: Id of a workspace.remote.servers[] endpoint to run the pipeline on; local when unset.

input_field.description: Context key sent as the sub-pipeline's prompt when messages are not forwarded.

forward_messages.description: Send the parent's full conversation instead of the flat prompt.

system_prompt.description: Plain-text system message for the sub-pipeline, replacing any existing system turn; not a Jinja template.

output_field.description: Context key receiving everything the sub-pipeline streamed; <step id>.output when unset.
